historicalApprovedIssues.title: Weapon and armor upgrades consume coins then fail

missed.earliestFailure: Economy/inventory coverage did not force a transaction to reconcile consumed currency with the exact required upgrade-material/item reference and delivery preconditions.
missed.repair: For every purchase/upgrade transaction, build a debit → prerequisite/material lookup → mutation/grant → success feedback chain and require Referential Integrity for every item/material identifier before SAFE.

missed.earliestFailure: Connection/recovery scenarios emphasized player reconnect but did not treat script/world reload during an active session as a first-class lifecycle interruption with world-object reconstruction dependencies.
missed.repair: Add active-session Reload Recovery differential: pre-reload authoritative session/world objects → bootstrap/reconstruction → required object/reference availability → fallback/abort behavior.

historicalComparison.conclusion: PvP unseen validation exposes two existing-mechanism gaps: transactional referential integrity and active-session reload recovery. No new issue family is required.

active arena → reload/bootstrap → in-memory/world-object reconstruction → required barricade/object lookup unavailable/inconsistent → recovery fallback aborts active arena
